verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a passing mention that Devin can connect to Figma through MCP integrations (devin-docs-21). That suggests the agent could pull in design mockups, but nothing shows attaching an image to a task or that Devin interprets visuals to implement UI changes. missing for 10: documented screenshot/image attachment on tasks (web app, Slack, or API), support for marked-up or annotated images, evidence that Devin's visual understanding turns mockups into correct UI changes, hands-on corroboration.
